manifest.name: Achordion
manifest.author: Parachord Team
manifest.description: Speed up resolver matches across the community. After a verified playback, sends the recording's MusicBrainz ID and the high-confidence streaming URLs from every resolver that matched the track to Achordion's match cache so other Parachord users can skip the search step. Also exposes window.achordion.fetchEntityLink for share-link URL generation. No personal data is sent.
